title: ApiContract
description: Version 1 free-play rooms, Liar's Dice, and Blackjack contracts. No wallet or chain operations.

TokenAmount.description: Exact base-unit integer string. Services must also enforce u128 and budget limits.

history.description: Public accepted actions only; no private dice or session credentials. Old snapshots may omit this field.

game.description: Defaults to LIARS_DICE for older clients. The web client selects BLACKJACK by default.

agents.description: Rule-based NPC seats: 1 adds Don Raccoone, 2 also adds Foxy. Defaults to 1.

cards.description: Face-up cards only. The hole card is never sent before the dealer reveals it.

BlackjackDealer.description: The house dealer. It has no seat and follows fixed rules.

phase.description: FINISHED only when the shoe has ended; hands continue while IN_PROGRESS.

handPhase.description: SHUFFLING (hand 0) precedes the first deal; RESULT shows the settled hand before the next deal.

nextHandAtEpochMillis.description: 0 unless the next hand of this shoe is scheduled.

BlackjackTally.description: Results across the hands of the current shoe. Blackjacks also count as wins.

BlackjackShoe.description: Casino-style shoe. commitment = SHA-256 hex of salt + ':' + comma-separated order (rank+suit), published before the first card. The reveal appears only after the shoe ends. It proves the order did not change during play, not that the shuffle was random.
